explanation: The value is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and at every D1 step before about trial 94, so it only turns on at the D1 fixation step of the last five or so trials of the episode (trials 95-99). In that stretch it jumps to 9-10 at one D1 and then falls to roughly half on each later trial D1 (for example 10, 6, 4, 2), and it can jump back to 9-10 again, often at trial 98 or 99, whether or not the previous trial was rewarded.
